content.decision: Use .pitmry/manifest.json and immutable .pitmry/records/YYYY/MM/*.json as canonical storage; keep only disposable derived state under .pitmry-cache/. Stop at Phase 1 before projections, ingestion, or retrieval work.
content.rationale: Git-tracked canonical JSON is the durable source of truth; derived indexes must remain rebuildable. Strict ID, project, manifest, shard, uniqueness, and relation-target validation prevents ambiguous or unsafe canonical state.
